LanguageData.OldScores_Settings_NicknamesDesc: A colonist who kills five of a faction's people (or its leader) gets a nickname from them, and their raiders may flee in dread when they see her.
LanguageData.OldScores_Settings_SparedDesc: A hostile captured by a colonist and later released may come back with a raid of his faction, and join the colony when he sees the one who captured him.
LanguageData.OldScores_Settings_BeastsDesc: A wild animal that badly hurts a colonist and gets away is named, scarred, and comes back one or two quadrums later, tougher and furious. Killing it leaves a trophy.
LanguageData.OldScores_Settings_EchoesDesc: Each map remembers how past raids came at the colony: the roads they walked, where they broke in, where they fell. An overlay toggle in the bottom-right icon row shows the faint echoes, and a message tells you when a faction comes by the same road again.
LanguageData.OldScores_Nickname_LetterText: {0} have started calling {1} "{2}". {3} of their people fell to {PAWN_objective}, and the story is going around their camps.\n\nTheir raiders may break and run when they see {PAWN_objective} up close.
LanguageData.OldScores_Nickname_LetterTextLeader: {1} killed {3}, the leader of {0}. They have started calling {PAWN_objective} "{2}", and nobody laughs when they say it.\n\nTheir raiders may break and run when they see {PAWN_objective} up close.
LanguageData.OldScores_Spared_Line1: You carried me out of the snow.
LanguageData.OldScores_Spared_Line2: {0}... you let me walk away. I remember.
LanguageData.OldScores_Spared_Line4: I owe you a life, {0}. I came to pay it.
LanguageData.OldScores_Spared_Line5: You gave me water when you had no reason to.
LanguageData.OldScores_Spared_LetterText:
{0} came back with a raid of {2}, and stopped dead when {PAWN_pronoun} saw {1}.

"{3}"

Once, {1} carried {PAWN_objective} in as a prisoner, and the colony let {PAWN_objective} go. {0} has thrown down {PAWN_possessive} weapon and joined the colony.
LanguageData.OldScores_Beast_LetterText: {0}, the {1} that hurt {2}, has come back. It is scarred, it is older, and it remembers the way here.\n\nIt will hunt your people until it dies or decides to leave again.
LanguageData.OldScores_Beast_KilledMessage: {0} is dead at last, killed by {1}. An old score is settled.
LanguageData.OldScores_Trophy_History: {0}, a {1}. It hurt {2} on {3} and got away. It came back scarred, and {4} killed it on {5}.
LanguageData.OldScores_Trophy_HistoryNoKiller: {0}, a {1}. It hurt {2} on {3} and got away. It came back scarred, and died on {4}.
LanguageData.OldScores_Echo_ToggleTip: Raid echoes: show the roads past raids took to the colony, where they broke in (rings) and where they fell (crosses). Older raids fade.
LanguageData.OldScores_Echo_OldRoad: They come by the old road again: {0}, from the {1}.
